name: st0-standalone
description: st0 and pl8 in one desktop app: their two backends, the file services pl8 starts, the supervisor and the engine, all on this machine. See docs/standalone.md.
author: F <fred@parapluie.org>

scripts.build:frontends: npm exec --workspace st0-frontend -- vite build && npm exec --workspace pl8-frontend -- vite build
scripts.package: node scripts/build-main.mjs && node scripts/stage.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs
